mapper.select: SELECT destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO , destroyRequest.INSERT_USER_CD requestUserCd , docsUser.USER_NM AS requestUserNm , (SELECT COMPANY_CD FROM DOCS_COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_CD = docsUser.COMPANY_CD) AS requestCompanyCd , (SELECT COMPANY_NM FROM DOCS_COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_CD = docsUser.COMPANY_CD) AS requestCompanyNm , destroyRequest.BUSINESS_AREA_CD , FN_GET_CD_NM('businessAreaCd', destroyRequest.BUSINESS_AREA_CD, #{sessionLang}) AS businessAreaNm , destroyRequest.INSERT_DT requestDt , (SELECT detail.ORIGINAL_USER_CD FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL detail WHERE detail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVAL') AS purchaserUserCd , (SELECT detail.REQUEST_DESC FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL detail WHERE detail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST') AS requestDesc , (SELECT detail.REQUEST_DESC FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL detail WHERE detail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND ACTION_CD = 'REJECT') AS rejectDesc , destroyRequest.Status_Cd AS statusCd FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST destroyRequest INNER JOIN DOCS_USER docsUser ON destroyRequest.INSERT_USER_CD = docsUser.USER_CD WHERE destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} AND ( destroyRequest.INSERT_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL accessDetail WHERE accessDetail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND (accessDetail.ORIGINAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR accessDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd}) ) )

SELECT dm.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO , dm.REQUEST_NO , dm.OBJECT_ID , dm.FILE_NO , dm.BUSINESS_AREA_CD , FN_GET_CD_NM('businessAreaCd', dm.BUSINESS_AREA_CD, #{sessionLang}) AS businessAreaNm , rf.ORG_FILE_NM , rf.FILE_NM , rf.FILE_SIZE , rf.PRINT_COUNT , m.REV_NO , m.DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_CD , FN_GET_CD_NM('distributeTypeCd', m.DISTRIBUTE_TYPE_CD, #{sessionLang}) AS distributeTypeNm , m.PRODUCT_CD , COALESCE(m.PRODUCT_CD, '') AS PRODUCT_NM , m.CURRENT_PAGE_NO , m.TOTAL_PAGE_NO , m.ECN_NO , m.STD_GAPP_DT , m.CHANGE_GAPP_DT , m.SW_VERSION_NO , m.DOC_VERSION_NO , m.BUSINESS_TYPE_CD , FN_GET_CD_NM('businessTypeCd', m.BUSINESS_TYPE_CD, #{sessionLang}) AS businessTypeNm , m.OBJECT_NM , m.OBJECT_NO , r.OBJECT_TYPE FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_MAPPING dm INNER JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_MAPPING m ON dm.REQUEST_NO = m.REQUEST_NO AND dm.OBJECT_ID = m.OBJECT_ID INNER JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_FILE rf ON dm.REQUEST_NO = rf.REQUEST_NO AND dm.OBJECT_ID = rf.OBJECT_ID AND dm.FILE_NO = rf.FILE_NO INNER JOIN DOCS_REQUEST r ON r.REQUEST_NO = m.REQUEST_NO WHERE dm.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST accessRequest WHERE accessRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = dm.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND ( accessRequest.INSERT_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL accessDetail WHERE accessDetail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = accessRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND (accessDetail.ORIGINAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR accessDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd}) ) ) )

SELECT destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO , destroyFile.DESTROY_NO , destroyFile.DESTROY_FILE_SEQ , COALESCE(NULLIF(destroyFile.FILE_NM, ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(destroyFile.FILE_PATH, '^.*[\\/]', ''), '')) AS fileName FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST destroyRequest JOIN DOCS_DESTROY_FILE destroyFile ON destroyFile.DESTROY_NO = CAST(destroyRequest.DESTROY_NO AS TEXT) WHERE destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} AND ( destroyRequest.INSERT_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL accessDetail WHERE accessDetail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND (accessDetail.ORIGINAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR accessDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd}) ) ) ORDER BY destroyFile.DESTROY_FILE_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO , destroyFile.DESTROY_NO , destroyFile.DESTROY_FILE_SEQ , destroyFile.FILE_PATH , COALESCE(NULLIF(destroyFile.FILE_NM, ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(destroyFile.FILE_PATH, '^.*[\\/]', ''), '')) AS fileName , destroyMapping.REQUEST_NO , CASE UPPER(request.OBJECT_TYPE) WHEN 'DOC' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'DOCUMENT' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'DRAWING' THEN 'DRAWING' WHEN 'SW' THEN 'SW' WHEN 'PRODUCT_DOC' THEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' WHEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' THEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' WHEN 'PRODUCT_SW' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'SECP' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'SECP_PARTDOC' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'DXF' THEN 'DXF' WHEN 'PEERREVIEW' THEN 'PEER_REVIEW' WHEN 'PEER_REVIEW' THEN 'PEER_REVIEW' END AS objectType , destroyMapping.OBJECT_ID , COALESCE(CAST(destroyMapping.FILE_NO AS TEXT), '*') AS fileNo FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST destroyRequest JOIN DOCS_DESTROY_FILE destroyFile ON destroyFile.DESTROY_NO = CAST(destroyRequest.DESTROY_NO AS TEXT) JOIN DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_MAPPING destroyMapping ON destroyMapping.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO JOIN DOCS_REQUEST request ON request.REQUEST_NO = destroyMapping.REQUEST_NO WHERE destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} AND destroyFile.DESTROY_FILE_SEQ = #{destroyFileSeq} AND ( destroyRequest.INSERT_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL accessDetail WHERE accessDetail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND (accessDetail.ORIGINAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR accessDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd}) ) ) AND CASE UPPER(request.OBJECT_TYPE) WHEN 'DOC' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'DOCUMENT' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'DRAWING' THEN 'DRAWING' WHEN 'SW' THEN 'SW' WHEN 'PRODUCT_DOC' THEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' WHEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' THEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' WHEN 'PRODUCT_SW' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'SECP' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'SECP_PARTDOC' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'DXF' THEN 'DXF' WHEN 'PEERREVIEW' THEN 'PEER_REVIEW' WHEN 'PEER_REVIEW' THEN 'PEER_REVIEW' END IS NOT NULL ORDER BY destroyMapping.REQUEST_NO, destroyMapping.OBJECT_ID, fileNo

SELECT destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST destroyRequest JOIN DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL currDetail ON currDetail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND currDetail.PROCESS_SEQ = destroyRequest.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO WHERE destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} AND destroyRequest.REQUEST_TYPE = 'DISTRIBUTION' AND destroyRequest.STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST' AND currDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVAL' AND currDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} AND currDetail.ACTION_CD = 'REQUEST' FOR UPDATE OF destroyRequest, currDetail
mapper.update: UPDATE DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = CASE WHEN #{saveFlag} = 'A' THEN 'APPROVAL' ELSE 'REJECT' END , DESTROY_DT = CASE WHEN #{saveFlag} = 'A' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END , APPROVAL_DT = CASE WHEN #{saveFlag} = 'A' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} AND REQUEST_TYPE = 'DISTRIBUTION' AND STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL currDetail WHERE currDetail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND currDetail.PROCESS_SEQ = DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO AND currDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVAL' AND currDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} AND currDetail.ACTION_CD = 'REQUEST' )

UPDATE DOCS_REQUEST_FILE SET DESTROY_STATUS_CD = CASE WHEN #{saveFlag} = 'A' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END /* 3:폐기승인, 4:폐기반려 */ WHERE (REQUEST_NO, OBJECT_ID, FILE_NO) IN ( SELECT REQUEST_NO, OBJECT_ID, CAST(FILE_NO AS TEXT) FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_MAPPING WHERE DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST destroyRequest JOIN DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL currDetail ON currDetail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND currDetail.PROCESS_SEQ = destroyRequest.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO WHERE destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} AND destroyRequest.REQUEST_TYPE = 'DISTRIBUTION' AND destroyRequest.STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST' AND currDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVAL' AND currDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} AND currDetail.ACTION_CD = 'REQUEST' )

UPDATE DOCS_APPROVAL_FILE SET DESTROY_STATUS_CD = CASE WHEN #{saveFlag} = 'A' THEN '3' ELSE '' END /* 3:폐기승인 */ , DESTROY_DT = CASE WHEN #{saveFlag} = 'A' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE (REQUEST_NO, OBJECT_ID, FILE_NO) IN ( SELECT REQUEST_NO, OBJECT_ID, CAST(FILE_NO AS TEXT) FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_MAPPING WHERE DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST destroyRequest JOIN DOCS_DESTROY_REQUEST_DETAIL currDetail ON currDetail.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO AND currDetail.PROCESS_SEQ = destroyRequest.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO WHERE destroyRequest.DESTROY_REQUEST_NO = #{destroyRequestNo} AND destroyRequest.REQUEST_TYPE = 'DISTRIBUTION' AND destroyRequest.STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST' AND currDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVAL' AND currDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} AND currDetail.ACTION_CD = 'REQUEST' )
